title: Spanish Picada

ingredientGroups.title: Base
items: 30 almonds, blanched and roasted (or half almonds/hazelnuts)
1 slice grilled bread, cubed (country style, not sourdough, 1.5” thick, no crust)

ingredientGroups.title: Optional Seasonings
items: Optional: pinch aniseeds, pinch cloves, pinch cinnamon, pinch paprika

steps: Fry garlic in oil over medium low heat until golden.
Meanwhile, toast the bread and almonds on a baking sheet at 350 degrees for about 8 minutes.
Pulse the toast and remaining ingredients in a food processor until mealy.
Fry with the garlic until a thick consistency.
sourceNote: Adapted for a recipe from Bulla Gastrobar Restaurante, Legacy West, Plano, TX

variants.title: Mortar and Pestle Picada
steps: Toast the saffron in a dry nonstick pan. Grind it with the salt in a mortar.
Add the garlic, almonds, and parsley. Crush to a thick paste, then stir into the dish.
